mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%, or the average 20d return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over three consecutive months indicates labor market deterioration, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 550,000 units in two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced confidence in the real estate sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic momentum and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% combined with a decline in non-farm payrolls below 130,000 indicates a labor market collapse, which triggers a flight to safety and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances where both conditions are met, or the joint signal fails to outperform a random baseline (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with a declining CPIAUCSL indicates a disinflationary monetary tightening, which reduces inflation expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 340,000 million dollars combined with a drop in industrial production below 95.0 signals a deepening demand contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of instances where both conditions are met, or the joint signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
